stock.description: Operating across the People's Republic of China, Suxin Joyful Life Services Co., Ltd., founded in 1994 and headquartered in Suzhou, is a comprehensive provider of property management and related services. The company caters to a diverse clientele, managing public infrastructure, commercial properties, and residential communities. Its urban services encompass the cleaning, greening, and upkeep of city roads, trams, and associated platforms, as well as routine inspections and maintenance for water supply networks and street lighting. It also undertakes refurbishment projects for building facades along key urban routes. Beyond city-wide infrastructure, Suxin Joyful Life extends its management expertise to public institutions such as museums, libraries, arts and sports centers, city parks, and office complexes, offering essential services like cleaning, security, gardening, landscaping, repairs, and general maintenance, alongside operating waste collection centers. The company further specializes in commercial property management, serving industrial parks, manufacturing facilities, office buildings, residential apartments, and shopping centers. Additionally, it delivers dedicated management for residential properties and offers property leasing solutions.
